Reserved Solana sysvar and program IDs, plus reserved-key check prototypes.

# Purpose
This header file declares the public identifiers for Solana sysvars, built-in programs, buffer accounts, and the migration authority used by the runtime. It also declares helper functions that test whether a `fd_pubkey_t` value is an active reserved key, a pending reserved key, or the `secp256r1` program key. The comments define the rules for reserved account handling and explain that reserved keys are excluded from the writable account cache, which affects transaction execution. The file serves as a central reference for runtime checks that depend on fixed account IDs and feature-gated reserved key rules.
